description: A legacy employee roster contains sensitive PII that must be sanitized before sharing with a vendor. Open '/home/ga/Documents/employee_roster_sensitive.odt'. Use the Find & Replace tool with Regular Expressions to: (1) Mask all Social Security Numbers (SSNs) formatted as '###-##-####' to show only the last 4 digits (e.g., 'XXX-XX-1234'), preserving the original last 4 digits using capture groups. (2) Sanitize all email addresses by replacing the domain name with '@redacted.com' (e.g., 'jane.doe@company.net' becomes 'jane.doe@redacted.com'), preserving the username. (3) Apply a Yellow highlight to all sanitized SSNs and Emails to mark them as processed. Save the sanitized document as '/home/ga/Documents/roster_sanitized.odt'.
